newsitem.title: SPAIN: Police inspector shot dead in Spain's Basque area.
newsitem.headline: Police inspector shot dead in Spain's Basque area.

text.p: A Spanish police inspector was killed by an unidentified gunman on Thursday in an apparent attack by ETA Basque separatist rebels, officials said.
Luis Andres Sanpedio was shot in the head outside his home in the northern Basque city of Bilbao by a lone gunman who fled by car.
Police later found the abandoned car and were on alert for a possible explosion. ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) often blows up its getaway cars.
Officials did not say whether ETA was responsible for the attack, but the separatist group has often targeted members of security forces and police in its 29-year struggle for independence.

Officials had expected increased violent activity by the group ahead of a "Day of Struggle" called by ETA for Friday to mark the two-year anniversary of its offer to negotiate peace with the government.
Madrid ignored the offer as part of a long-standing policy of refusing to hold talks with groups that do not renounce violence.
